# ProcureAtlas

> Evidence-first manufacturer discovery and procurement decision layer. Initial vertical: packaging machinery in China.

## Core principles
- Manufacturer pages distinguish public-source evidence from factory-audit status.
- Missing capability data must not be inferred as true.
- Organic matching is intended to remain independent from paid placement.
